prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a large two-storey hall or inn in an underground city carved inside a huge cave. Carved stone overhang roof. Walls carved directly into grey rock with iron-bound wooden doors and small round windows, pipes. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 272 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the ATTACHED exact layout guide into ONE standalone pixel-art building sprite; use the guide as a STRICT spatial template, not as inspiration. Output canvas exactly 272 x 224 art pixels (reference image shown at 7x scale, 1904x1568); transparent alpha everywhere currently magenta, with NO ground or shadows. Maintain all silhouettes and coordinates in ART PIXELS: roof overhang x=2..269, y=28..133, straight horizontal roof/fascia division at y=75..76; upper roof plane y=28..74, downward-facing thick carved-stone roof edge/fascia y=77..133. Straight-on front wall x=8..263 from y=134..223; preserve its bottom ground line. Exact windows: upper-floor aperture bounding boxes x=44..59,100..115,154..169,210..225 y=148..167; lower x=44..59,98..113,210..225 y=192..211. Keep ALL SEVEN windows in those boxes, identically sized and aligned, amber-yellow glowing interior glass, with small round iron-framed apertures carved WITHIN each rectangular box without relocating the frames. Exact one and ONLY WALKABLE DOOR x=141..162, y=192..223, dark-brown iron-bound wooden door which reaches ground at bottom of canvas; NEVER move or shrink it. Large two-storey inn/hall hewn directly from grey cave rock, broad massive carved layered stone overhang roof seen from above in classic 3/4 top-down JRPG map view, straight frontal wall below. Worn broad grey-blue stone plates, carefully shaped cracks, stone ridges and chisel marks in roof, strong straight overhanging front roof lip, two-storey carved grey rock facade with subtly legible stone courses, thin iron pipes running across unused wall spaces, iron bands on door, tiny inset window stone surrounds. Stone and metal predominantly cool grey with saturated muted purple-red shadow ramp and restrained warm yellow highlights; earthy brown door; windows are the ONLY light sources, no external pools of light. Neutral soft even ambient upper-left light, clean base sprite not dark nighttime. Premium modern hi-bit hand-placed JRPG 2D pixel art: single uniformly sized square pixel grid, sharp hard-edged blocky pixel clusters of 3–10 pixels, purposeful 4–6 shade hue-shifted ramps per material, crisp pixel stair steps and no anti-aliasing, no smoothing, no gradients, no blur, no photo texture, no noise or checkerboard dithering. Retain flat guide silhouette and exact seven windows, door, and roof split, not a perspective view of the front wall, no additional structures, no letters or text. Transparent background, NOT magenta.
